# Manual Hindi semantic review — batch 047

Date: 2026-10-14  
Scope: English sense indices 1150–1174, 25 senses

I reread every English definition and source example and checked the Hindi gloss and example. I simplified the core verb definitions and corrected Hindi phrasing for `keep`, `change` (noun), `call`, and `receive`; this removes an extra meaning from `call` and makes the examples natural for learners.

Changed: 25 English definitions and 4 Hindi gloss/example pairs. Refreshed source fingerprints for these 25 senses in the locale status files.  
Progress: 1,175/8,837 Hindi word senses independently checked (13.29%); 7,662 remain.

This batch does not complete the overall semantic review; more batches remain.
